metadata.description: Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.

properties.description: Fires when a single source IP racks up 10+ failed RDP logons (Event ID 4625) against the honeypot within a 5-minute window. Threshold tuned against this lab's observed internet-scanning baseline to separate noisy background scans from focused brute-force bursts.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where LogonType in (3, 10)
| summarize FailedAttempts = count(), TargetAccounts = make_set(Account) by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FailedAttempts >= 10
| project TimeGenerated, IpAddress, FailedAttempts, TargetAccounts

properties.description: High-severity correlation: an IP with a burst of failed logons (4625) followed by a SUCCESSFUL logon (4624) from that same IP within 10 minutes. Indicates a brute-force attack that actually succeeded, not just internet background-scan noise.
properties.query:
let FailedLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 4625
    | summarize FailedAttempts = count() by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where FailedAttempts >= 10;
let SuccessfulLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 4624
    | where LogonType in (3, 10)
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, IpAddress, Account, Computer;
FailedLogons
| join kind=inner SuccessfulLogons on IpAddress
| where SuccessTime between (TimeGenerated .. TimeGenerated + 10m)
| project TimeGenerated, IpAddress, FailedAttempts, SuccessTime, Account, Computer
